frames.heading: Solstice
frames.body: Your light... it's more vibrant and harmonious than I imagined!!!

frames.heading: Traveller
frames.body: That's the spirit, Solstice! Let's place down the amp, only one left to go!

frames.heading: Mojo
frames.body: Now, let's head to the final platform.

frames.heading: Traveller
frames.body: This place... it's the complete opposite of Solstice's platform. Pure chaos.

frames.heading: Discord
frames.body: I am Discord, the guardian of this platform. Why do you dare to step into my domain?

frames.heading: Traveller
frames.body: Discord, we're here to free the universe from the Grand Composer's control. Crescendo, Nox, and Solstice have all joined us. Now it's your turn to see the power of our harmony!

frames.heading: Discord
frames.body: Joined you? Those weaklings. The Grand Composer's harmony is a lie, but so is your so-called freedom. Only chaos is truly honest.

frames.heading: Traveller
frames.body: Chaos without purpose is just noise, Discord. We bring a harmony that embraces all rhythms, even yours.

frames.heading: Discord
frames.body: Hah! Prove to me that your so-called groove can tame the chaos of my domain.

frames.heading: Traveller
frames.body: Challenge accepted, Discord. Let's show him what we've got, Mojo!
